title: The Cost of Saying Hello: An Empirical Study of Handshake Overhead in AI Agent Communication Protocols
abstract: arXiv:2610.30151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Every interaction between AI agents begins with a handshake: the initiating agent must locate its counterpart, learn what it can do, and establish a session before the first useful message can be sent. Surveys of agent communication protocols name handshake overhead as an efficiency criterion, yet none report measurements. This paper presents the first empirical, phase-decomposed benchmark of the handshake in three major agent protocols: MCP (in both its 2025 initialize and 2026 discover eras), A2A, and ACP. Using each protocol's official SDK, we instrument every request for round trips, per-phase latency, wire bytes, and token cost across cold-start, warm-repeat, capability-mismatch, and degraded-metadata scenarios (N=50 per cell, on loopback and under an emulated 50 ms RTT). translated_title: 打招呼的代价：AI智能体通信协议中握手开销的实证研究
translated_abstract: AI智能体之间的每一次交互都始于一次握手：发起方智能体必须先定位对方、了解对方的能力，并建立会话，才能发送第一条有用的消息。关于智能体通信协议的综述将握手开销列为效率评估标准之一，然而此前没有任何研究提供过实测数据。本文首次对三大主流智能体协议——MCP（涵盖其2025年的initialize时期和2026年的discover时期）、A2A和ACP——中的握手过程进行了分阶段的实证基准测试。我们使用各协议的官方SDK，在冷启动、热重复、能力不匹配和元数据退化等场景下（每格N=50次，分别在本地回环和模拟50 ms往返延迟条件下），对每个请求的往返次数、各阶段延迟、传输字节数和令牌成本进行了测量。结果表明，往返次数主导了握手成本：旧版MCP握手需要三次往返，在50 ms往返延迟下耗时230 ms；而A2A仅需一次往返，耗时61.0 ms。
tldr: 本文首次对MCP、A2A和ACP三种AI智能体通信协议的握手开销进行分阶段实证测量，发现往返次数是握手成本的主导因素——旧版MCP需三次往返耗时230 ms，而A2A仅需一次往返耗时61 ms。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first empirical, phase-decomposed benchmark of handshake overhead in AI agent communication protocols (MCP, A2A, ACP), showing that round-trip count dominates handshake cost—legacy MCP requires three round trips (230 ms at 50 ms RTT) while A2A needs only one (61.0 ms).
